systems.system: Registers of land allocations kept by allocating authorities
systems.owner: land allocating authorities and local councils, reporting every 3 months to the Commissioner
systems.tiers: each allocating authority, rural and urban; the regulations do not say the register is electronic

systems.system: Register of land held by minors
systems.tiers: national; copies to the Commissioner and the Registrar or allocating authority

note: Land regulations (an excerpt, regulations 1 to 9): land registers only, out of scope; nothing on civil registration.
